 Live Election 2026 live results: Dems take back Congress, Troy Jackson unseats Sen. Susan Collins in Maine 
 Collins is the five-term senator from Maine. 
 Live The sun sets on the U.S. Capitol on Election Day evening on November 3, 2026 in Washington. Kevin Dietsch/Getty Images By ABC NEWS Last Updated: November 4, 2026, 1:20 AM EST Share Democrats have won several key races in the high-stakes midterm elections -- with ABC News projecting that Democrats will take control of the Senate and the House.
 Watch ABC beginning at 7 p.m. EST for live Election Night 2026 coverage and results. Also streaming on Disney+ and Hulu. 
 Key Headlines
 14 minutes ago Trump on midterm results: 'I think part of it was Iran' 
 26 minutes ago Schumer takes victory lap; promises to deliver for Americans 'with or without the president' 
 33 minutes ago Maine Democrat Troy Jackson projected to win Senate race over incumbent Sen. Collins 
 Here's how the news is developing. 14 minutes ago 
 Trump on midterm results: 'I think part of it was Iran' 
 President Donald Trump said he was "a little bit surprised" by the midterm results and that he thought Republicans would "do better" during a lengthy phone interview with Fox News.
 Asked what his takeaways are on the results, Trump said, "I think part of it was Iran," and later drew a more direct link between Iran and gas prices.
 "People agree with what I'm doing on Iran, but they really probably weren't willing to do the short-term consequence of paying more for gasoline, and that, you know, I understand that," he said.
 Trump said he would work with Democrats and, when asked if he would accept tonight’s election results, responded, "Yeah, sure, I’ll accept. Why wouldn't I?"
 He said he doesn't view the results as "a hit on me."
 "We've had the greatest two years in the history of the presidency in terms of the economy, in terms of all the things that we've done," he said.
 -ABC News' Michelle Stoddart, Lalee Ibssa and Nicholas Kerr 
 26 minutes ago 
 Schumer takes victory lap; promises to deliver for Americans 'with or without the president' 
 An excited Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer took a victory lap after Democrats are projected to also win control of the Senate, lamenting Republicans for embracing President Trump, pointing directly at him as the reason why Republicans lost control of Congress.
 “We listened to the American people…We listened. They didn't," Schumer said.
 Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer speaks during a press conference, November 3, 2026 in Washington. Tom Brenner/Getty Images 
 Schumer brushed aside concern about Trump vowing to become the “veto President,” telling reporters, "Look, we're going to deliver for the people of America with or without the president."
 -ABC News' Lalee Ibssa 
 26 minutes ago 
 GOP Sen. Marsha Blackburn projected to win Tennessee governor 
 Republican Sen. Marsha Blackburn is projected to win the race for Tennessee governor, defeating Memphis city councilor Jerri Green.
 28 minutes ago 
 New Hampshire GOP Gov. Kelly Ayotte projected to win reelection 
 New Hampshire GOP Gov. Kelly Ayotte is projected to defeat her Democratic challenger Cinde Warmington and be reelected.
